entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Manipulated Amonkhet's leyline gods to his own ends.

entities.name: O-Kagachi
entities.description: Most powerful kami and guardian of Kakuriyo and Utsushiyo and the boundary between them.

entities.name: Lord Takeshi Konda
entities.description: Stole the great kami's heart in 3207 AR, starting the Kami War.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War started when O-Kagachi was enraged.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: Child of O-Kagachi who took over guarding the boundary between realms.

entities.name: Myojin
entities.description: The five most powerful kami after O-Kagachi, each representing a color.

entities.name: Deep Gods
entities.description: Children of Chimil and the gods of the Oltec.

entities.name: Einir
entities.description: Ancient ruling gods of Kaldheim who sealed the demons in Innistrum.

entities.name: Skoti
entities.description: Took over the Einir's role as gods of Kaldheim.

events.summary: Lord Takeshi Konda steals O-Kagachi's heart in 3207 AR, enraging it and starting the Kami War.
events.quote: Lord Takeshi Konda stole the great kami's "heart" and a portion of its power

events.summary: The Skoti challenge the Einir and take over their role as the plane's gods.
events.quote: The Skoti challenged the power of the Einir and took over their role as the plane's gods.

relations.quote: Kyodai is the child of O-Kagachi
The Deep Gods are children of Chimil
The Skoti challenged the power of the Einir
